question: Compare MMT-PROBE and secAnoD as attack detection options.
groundTruth: Both Montimage. MMT-PROBE: DPI traffic probe, Monitor category, TRL 7->8, input pod network traffic, output DPI alerts/reports. secAnoD: explainable LLM-based anomaly detection/prediction, Ops Services, TRL 3->7, input threat intel & telemetry, output anomaly predictions.
